prompt: By how many years does the inception of the party to which former Finnish MP Lea Rakel Hiltunen last belonged predate the foundation of the Parliament of Finland itself?
answer: Former MP Lea Rakel Hiltunen last belonged to the **Social Democratic Party of Finland (SDP)**, founded in **1899**. The Parliament of Finland was founded in **1906**, so the party predates it by **7 years**.
